notes.title: Parallel Experiment - Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New animations for Bogdan
[*] Improved character selection screen
[*] Added a new Extras menu in the main menu - browse achievements and find links to our other games
[*] Clearer notifications after completing a puzzle in the Bar section
[*] Improved accessibility: added visual clues to puzzles that previously required sound, making them playable for hard-of-hearing players
[*] Removed reliance on Cloudflare to reduce connection issues for players in Russia
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed reliance on Cloud Flare to reduce connection issues for players from Russia region
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from continuing conversations with Bogdan
[/list]

notes.title: Parallel Experiment - Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Features
[list]
[*] Added and option to change graphic quality - should help with performance on lower-end machines
[*] Improved performance in more resource-intensive areas (Inside of Dad's Electronics, the labyrinth). This should prevent game from crashing in these areas
[*] Improved the reset procedure in the pipe minigame
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause players to lose their save file. If this happened to you, please let us know and we’ll provide a save file close to where you left off
[*] Fixed a visual bug with one of the characters disappearing during a conversation
[*] Fixed a bug that broke the mouse game if a player quits during the ending sequence
[*] Fixed a missing diode bug in the communication machine
[*] Fixed a bug with gems overlapping in Match Three minigame
[/list]

notes.title: Parallel Experiment - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to choose a server when starting a game — useful if you experience connection or lag issues
[*] Reduced graphic requirements in larger sections, especially in the underground area. This should prevent game from crashing in these areas
[*] Save files are now automatically backed up
[*] The game now remembers your selected language
[*] Added the ability to reset the Pipe Puzzle and the Gears & Sliders Puzzle
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the map icon from bouncing when it should draw attention
[*] Fixed typos and improved wording in Polish and Russian
[*] Fixed an issue that could block three in a row puzzle completion in specific situations
[*] Fixed an issue where some notes weren’t translated correctly
[*] Minor visual improvements in the Temple and Platforms puzzles
[/list]

notes.title: Parallel Experiment - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
We’re releasing our first bugfix patch. If you encounter any other bugs, please contact us at support@elevenpuzzles.com, and we’ll address the issue as quickly as possible. Thank you for playing our game!

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Added two additional servers in Hong Kong and Tel Aviv to reduce connection problems for certain players.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the game from connecting to a backup server after a timeout during game creation.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing players from making a move after a reset in the Guliver’s game.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some sound effects from being correctly controlled by the volume sliders.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Gears and Sliders puzzle that duplicated a tile and made the puzzle unsolvable.
[*] Fixed a bug that, in some circumstances, prevented players from switching to a correct location when using a map in Investigation Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Parallel Lab is no more! It's Parallel Experiment Now!
notes.content:
[h2][i]Hello Detectives![/i] 🕵️🕵️[/h2]
[h3]We're thrilled to announce a significant change to the next chapter of the 'Cryptic Killer' series. Get ready for Parallel Experiment, a game that's not just a sequel but a groundbreaking evolution in our cooperative puzzle adventures.[/h3]

[h1]🎉What's New in Parallel Experiment?[/h1]

[h3][list]
[*] [b]A New, Riveting Chapter[/b]
Join detectives Old Dog and Ally in their relentless pursuit of the Cryptic Killer. This time, they're unraveling the mystery of the Parallel Experiment. But beware – it could be another trap!

[*][b]A Story Full of Mysteries[/b]
Learn the motives of the Cryptic Killer. Is he working alone? Maybe someone helps him? Or maybe there is something more behind his twisted ideas?

[*][b]Our Biggest Title Yet[/b]
Get ready for a long puzzle solving journey! Parallel Experiment will be significantly bigger than Unboxing the Cryptic Killer with Demo longer than entire Unsolved Case!

[*] [b]Enhanced Co-Op Experience[/b]
You and a friend will have new, exciting ways to solve puzzles together and interact with each other while doing so.

[*] [b]A Rich, Interactive World[/b]
Explore the city of Cracow, filled with hand-illustrated environments inspired by noir novels. The game's world is more alive and interactive than ever.
[/list][/h3]

[h1]🗓️Release and Demo[/h1]

[h3]We're pouring our hearts and souls into making Parallel Experiment a memorable and engaging game that tests your detective skills and teamwork. As we push the boundaries with a vast scope and innovative mechanics, time is essential to meet our vision of the experience we want to deliver.

[list]
[*] [b]Steam Next Fest Demo [/b] - February 5th 2024
Get a taste of the challenge with a substantial demo – bigger and better than entire Unsolved Case!

[*] [b]Release Date[/b] - Gear up for the full experience, launching in 2024.
[/list]
Wishlist now to stay updated on the journey to release.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to see how you tackle the Cryptic Killer's new challenges!🙏

[i]Eleven Puzzles Team [/i][/h3]
